[Feature] MRV2 Sfa support graph mode (#13958)

### What this PR does / why we need it?
SFA Graph Mode Support: Introduced support for SFA (Sparse Fine-grained
Attention) in graph mode, including updates to attention metadata
handling and sequence length management.
Indexer Cache Backend Integration: Routed SFA indexer cache layers to
the Ascend-specific backend by patching DeepseekV32IndexerCache and
implementing custom allocation logic for sparse C8 indexer tensors.
### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?
NO
### How was this patch tested?


- vLLM version: v0.26.0
- vLLM main:

[CI] nightly base image date defaults to latest, with manual input support (#14224)

What this PR does / why we need it?
Adds a base_image_date option for nightly builds. Default auto
backtracks day by day (up to 30 days) to pick the latest date that
actually has a quay base image, so the build no longer fails when
today's image isn't out yet. You can also set a specific date (YYYYMMDD)
to pin it. Only affects the daily build.

Does this PR introduce any user-facing change?
No This is for internal nightly testing only

How was this patch tested?
1、**auto**:
 Inputs
    target: a2
    vllm_ascend_branch: main
    build_type: daily
    quay_daily_username: atlas_inference+robot
    cann_version: 2026.08.03
    base_image_date: auto
base_image_tag: {"cann_version":"2026.08.03","base_image_date":"auto"}
Tag nightly-main-cann2026.08.03-20260813 not found, trying previous
day...
Tag nightly-main-cann2026.08.03-20260812 not found, trying previous
day...
Found base image date: 20260811 (tag:
nightly-main-cann2026.08.03-20260811)
2、**specified date**:
 Inputs
    target: a2
    vllm_ascend_branch: main
    build_type: daily
    quay_daily_username: atlas_inference+robot
    cann_version: 2026.08.03
    base_image_date: 20260809
base_image_tag:
{"cann_version":"2026.08.03","base_image_date":"20260809"}
load metadata for
quay.io/atlas_inference/vllm-ascend:nightly-main-openeuler-cann2026.08.03-20260809

- vLLM main:
https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/58d3918e3ea0a544ffedadad2ba84559e9c51d8f

[CI][Misc] main2main vllm v0.27.1 (#14027)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

main2main vllm upgrade to v0.27.1

---

Update CI tracking tag: `.github/vllm-release-tag.commit` from `v0.26.0`
to `v0.27.1`, and adapt the codebase so vllm-ascend works on both vLLM
v0.27.1 and vLLM main.

#### 1. Version / CI / Docker / Documentation

| File | Change Reason |
|------|---------------|
| `.github/vllm-release-tag.commit` | Update CI tracking tag: `v0.26.0`
→ `v0.27.1` |
| `Dockerfile`, `Dockerfile.310p`, `Dockerfile.310p.openEuler`,
`Dockerfile.a3`, `Dockerfile.a3.openEuler`, `Dockerfile.a5`,
`Dockerfile.a5.openEuler`, `Dockerfile.openEuler` | `ARG
VLLM_TAG=v0.26.0` → `v0.27.1` |
| `README.md`, `README.zh.md` | Update main branch description: CI
commitment for vLLM `v0.26.0` → `v0.27.1` tag |

#### 2. Drop v0.26.0 version gates (v0.27.1 upstream matches main)

All `vllm_version_is("0.26.0")` branches whose behavior v0.27.1 no
longer needs were removed, keeping only the current signatures. Upstream
vLLM PRs that landed before v0.27.1:

| File | Change Reason |
|------|---------------|
| `vllm_ascend/distributed/weight_transfer/__init__.py`,
`npu_ipc_engine.py`, `examples/rl/rlhf_http_npu_ipc.py`,
`tests/ut/distributed/weight_transfer/test_npu_ipc_engine.py`,

[BugFix][CI] Forward upload script stderr in nightly result postprocess (#14051)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

`upload_to_openlibing.py` uses Python `logging`, which writes to stderr.
`_run_postprocess_script` captured both streams but only printed stdout
on success, and only printed stderr when the exit code was non-zero.

As a result, after `OPENLIBING_SECRET` was configured and upload
succeeded, CI only showed `Postprocess JSON written to ...` with no
upload success/failure details, which made debugging difficult.

This PR always forwards stdout/stderr from the upload subprocess, and
still prints a Warning when the exit code is non-zero. Upload failure
continues to be best-effort and does not fail the benchmark test case.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

No. CI-only logging improvement for nightly/weekly postprocess upload.

### How was this patch tested?

- Verified locally that success/failure logs from
`upload_to_openlibing.py` are printed by `_run_postprocess_script`.
- Nightly debug runs for `qwen3-32b-int8` (e.g. Nightly-A2:
https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/actions/runs/31553200411)
observed that without this fix, upload produced no logs after JSON
write; this change addresses that.

https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/actions/runs/31561503582/job/94005553056

[BugFix] [w8a8_mxfp8] Reuse weight address in graph and RL scenario (#13902)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

In RL workflows (e.g. verl), rollout weights are reloaded into the model
repeatedly, and after each reload
`AscendW8A8MXFP8DynamicLinearMethod.process_weights_after_loading` is
invoked again to transform the weight (transpose) and scale (reshape +
transpose) into the layout consumed by ACL.

Before this fix, every call re-allocated the transformed tensors via
`.contiguous()`, so `layer.weight.data` / `layer.weight_scale.data` got
a new `data_ptr` on each reload. When ACL graph mode is enabled, the
graph captures the buffer addresses on the first capture and replays
against them; after a reload the captured addresses point to freed/stale
memory, so graph replay reads garbage and produces garbled output.

  This PR makes the transformed buffer stable across reloads:
- On the first `process_weights_after_loading`, allocate the contiguous
transformed buffers once and cache them on the layer as
`_mxfp8_weight_buf` / `_mxfp8_scale_buf`.
- On subsequent calls (the RL reload path), copy the reloaded
original-shape data in place into the cached buffers via `copy_()`, then
point `layer.weight.data` / `layer.weight_scale.data` back at the cached
buffers.

As a result the buffer `data_ptr` and contiguity never change across
reloads, so ACL graph replay always reads the live, contiguous weights
and produces correct output.

  ### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

No API/interface change. Behaviorally this fixes the garbled output that
occurred in RL + ACL graph mode scenarios after a weight reload; non-RL
and non-graph-mode paths are unaffected.

  ### How was this patch tested?

Added
`TestAscendW8A8MXFP8LinearMethod.test_transform_buffer_data_ptr_stable_across_reloads`,
which:
- Transforms once and records the `data_ptr` of `_mxfp8_weight_buf` /
`_mxfp8_scale_buf`.
- Loops 3 times over: `restore_weights_for_rl_loading` -> simulate
`model.load_weights()` writing new data via `copy_()` ->
`process_weights_after_loading`.
- Asserts the buffer `data_ptr` and `layer.weight.data` /
`layer.weight_scale.data` `data_ptr` stay stable, and that all four
tensors remain contiguous, both after the first transform and after
every reload.

  Run on an NPU machine:

  ```bash
pytest
tests/ut/quantization/methods/test_w8a8_mxfp8.py::TestAscendW8A8MXFP8LinearMethod::test_transform_buffer_data_ptr_stable_across_reloads
-v
```
  Existing tests in the same file continue to pass.
- vLLM version: v0.26.0
- vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/0351e9aa1fdf1a51329d1906881528dfe61fc88e

Signed-off-by: kyle-zhangchi <chiiiiiizhang@gmail.com>

-            layer.weight_scale.data = F.pad(layer.weight_scale.data, (0, 1), mode="constant", value=0)
-            layer.weight_scale.data = layer.weight_scale.data.reshape(n_dim, k_dim // 2 + 1, 2)
+            reshaped_scale = F.pad(layer.weight_scale.data, (0, 1), mode="constant", value=0)
+            reshaped_scale = reshaped_scale.reshape(n_dim, k_dim // 2 + 1, 2)
+        else:
+            reshaped_scale = layer.weight_scale.data.reshape(n_dim, k_dim // 2, 2)
+        target_scale = reshaped_scale.transpose(0, 1)
+
+        if not hasattr(layer, "_mxfp8_weight_buf"):
+            # First call: allocate the persistent transformed buffers.
+            layer._mxfp8_weight_buf = layer.weight.data.transpose(0, 1).contiguous()
+            layer._mxfp8_scale_buf = target_scale.contiguous()
         else:
-            layer.weight_scale.data = layer.weight_scale.data.reshape(n_dim, k_dim // 2, 2)
-        layer.weight.data = layer.weight.data.transpose(0, 1).contiguous()
-        layer.weight_scale.data = layer.weight_scale.data.transpose(0, 1).contiguous()
+            # Subsequent calls (RL reload path): copy in place to keep data_ptr stable.
+            layer._mxfp8_weight_buf.copy_(layer.weight.data.transpose(0, 1).contiguous())
+            layer._mxfp8_scale_buf.copy_(target_scale.contiguous())
+
+        layer.weight.data = layer._mxfp8_weight_buf
+        layer.weight_scale.data = layer._mxfp8_scale_buf
 
         # Mark as transformed
         layer._mxfp8_transformed = True

@@ -0,0 +1,400 @@
+# SOME DESCRIPTIVE TITLE.
+# Copyright (C) 2026, vllm-ascend team
+# This file is distributed under the same license as the vllm-ascend package.
+# FIRST AUTHOR <EMAIL@ADDRESS>, 2026.
+#
+msgid ""
+msgstr ""
+"Project-Id-Version: vllm-ascend\n"
+"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To: \n"
+"POT-Creation-Date: 2026-08-13 02:44+0000\n"
+"PO-Revision-Date: 2026-08-13 02:44+0000\n"
+"Last-Translator: \n"
+"Language-Team: zh_CN <LL@li.org>\n"
+"Language: zh_CN\n"
+"MIME-Version: 1.0\n"
+"Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\n"
+"Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit\n"
+"Plural-Forms: nplurals=1; plural=0;\n"
+"Generated-By: detect_po_changes.py\n"
+
+msgid "# SFA Remote D2H Connector Design"
+msgstr "# SFA 远程 D2H 连接器设计"
+
+msgid "## Purpose and Scope"
+msgstr "## 目的与范围"
+
+msgid ""
+"`SfaRemoteD2HConnector` transfers SFA KV cache from a remote Prefill worker into\n"
+"the Decode-side layout owned by `SparseKVOffloadManager`. It is a KV Connector\n"
+"V1 implementation for Prefill-Decode disaggregation with sparse Decode\n"
+"offload."
+msgstr ""
+"`SfaRemoteD2HConnector` 将 SFA KV 缓存从远程 Prefill 工作节点传输到由 "
+"`SparseKVOffloadManager` 拥有的 Decode 侧布局中。它是用于带有稀疏 Decode 卸载的 Prefill-Decode "
+"分离架构的 KV 连接器 V1 实现。"
+
+msgid ""
+"RD2H means **remote device to local host**. The connector uses a pull model:"
+msgstr "RD2H 表示**远程设备到本地主机**。该连接器采用拉取模型："
+
+msgid ""
+"- Prefill registers and exposes its NPU KV cache.\n"
+"- Decode owns the destinations and pulls data through MemFabric.\n"
+"- Prefill publishes source metadata and per-layer readiness over ZMQ.\n"
+"- Decode acknowledges every layer after the read succeeds or fails."
+msgstr ""
+"- Prefill 注册并暴露其 NPU KV 缓存。\n"
+"- Decode 拥有目标端并通过 MemFabric 拉取数据。\n"
+"- Prefill 通过 ZMQ 发布源元数据和逐层就绪状态。\n"
+"- Decode 在每次读取成功或失败后确认每一层。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The connector provides transport and completion signaling. The Decode top-k\n"
+"resident-cache algorithm remains in `SparseKVOffloadManager` and the SFA\n"
+"offload attention backend. AscendStore Layerwise Prefill KV Cache Offload is an\n"
+"optional, separately configured feature."
+msgstr ""
+"该连接器提供传输和完成信号机制。Decode 的 top-k 常驻缓存算法保留在 `SparseKVOffloadManager` 和 SFA "
+"卸载注意力后端中。AscendStore 分层 Prefill KV 缓存卸载是一个可选且独立配置的功能。"
+
+msgid ""
+"For user-facing configuration and deployment constraints, see\n"
+"[Layerwise and Sparse KV Cache Offloading](../../user_guide/feature_guide/layerwise_and_sparse_kv_cache_offloading.md)."
+msgstr ""
+"有关面向用户的配置和部署约束，请参阅\n"
+"[分层与稀疏 KV 缓存卸载](../../user_guide/feature_guide/layerwise_and_sparse_kv_cache_offloading.md)。"
+
+msgid "## Data Ownership"
+msgstr "## 数据所有权"
+
+msgid ""
+"The Decode destination contains main KV and indexer KV with different\n"
+"ownership rules."
+msgstr "Decode 目标端包含主 KV 和索引器 KV，二者具有不同的所有权规则。"
+
+msgid "| Component | Prefill source | Decode destination |"
+msgstr "| 组件 | Prefill 源端 | Decode 目标端 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Main K/V | Regular paged NPU cache, replicated across Prefill TP ranks | "
+"TP-shared pinned CPU pool owned by `SparseKVOffloadManager` |"
+msgstr ""
+"| 主 K/V | 常规分页 NPU 缓存，在 Prefill TP 各 rank 间复制 | 由 `SparseKVOffloadManager` "
+"拥有的 TP 共享固定 CPU 池 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Indexer | Rank-local NPU cache | Complete rank-local NPU copy on every "
+"Decode TP rank |"
+msgstr "| 索引器 | Rank 本地 NPU 缓存 | 每个 Decode TP rank 上的完整 rank 本地 NPU 副本 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| LIC8 scale | Optional tensor following the indexer layout | Optional rank-"
+"local NPU tensor |"
+msgstr "| LIC8 缩放 | 可选张量，遵循索引器布局 | 可选的 rank 本地 NPU 张量 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"Each Decode TP rank transfers a disjoint share of main KV into the shared CPU\n"
+"pool. Main and indexer block IDs remain separate in scheduler metadata and wire\n"
+"messages. A uniform KV-cache group may map them to the same vLLM block group,\n"
+"but the connector does not depend on group ordering."
+msgstr ""
+"每个 Decode TP rank 将主 KV 的不相交部分传输到共享 CPU 池中。主块 ID 和索引器块 ID "
+"在调度器元数据和线协议消息中保持分离。统一的 KV 缓存组可能将它们映射到同一个 vLLM 块组，但连接器不依赖于组顺序。"
+
+msgid "## Request Lifecycle"
+msgstr "## 请求生命周期"
+
+msgid "### Decode allocation and rendezvous"
+msgstr "### Decode 分配与会合"
+
+msgid ""
+"For a request with `do_remote_prefill=true`, Decode reports the remaining\n"
+"prompt tokens as asynchronously matched and lets vLLM allocate the main and\n"
+"indexer destinations. It records those block IDs locally, advertises its host,\n"
+"base port, parallel topology, and cached-token count through the proxy\n"
+"metaserver, and then clears `do_remote_prefill`."
+msgstr ""
+"对于 `do_remote_prefill=true` 的请求，Decode 将剩余的提示词 token 报告为异步匹配，并让 vLLM "
+"分配主目标和索引器目标。它在本地记录这些块 ID，通过代理元服务器通告其主机、基础端口、并行拓扑和缓存 token 数量，然后清除 "
+"`do_remote_prefill`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Decode block IDs never leave Decode. Prefill only receives the endpoint and\n"
+"cached-token information needed to publish its sources."
+msgstr "Decode 块 ID 永远不会离开 Decode。Prefill 仅接收发布其源端所需的端点和缓存 token 信息。"
+
+msgid "### Prefill scheduling"
+msgstr "### Prefill 调度"
+
+msgid ""
+"The proxy dispatches the request to Prefill with `do_remote_decode=true`.\n"
+"Prefill tracks its source block IDs, the Decode endpoint, computed and\n"
+"transferred token counts, and chunk completion."
+msgstr ""
+"代理将请求以 `do_remote_decode=true` 分发给 Prefill。Prefill 跟踪其源块 ID、Decode "
+"端点、已计算和已传输的 token 数量以及分块完成状态。"
+
+msgid ""
+"For chunked Prefill, a metadata update covers newly completed blocks. The final\n"
+"chunk also includes its partial block. OpenAI prompt lists are expanded into\n"
+"child requests on Decode; the proxy collects all child rendezvous metadata and\n"
+"dispatches the original list to Prefill once."
+msgstr ""
+"对于分块 Prefill，元数据更新涵盖新完成的块。最后一个分块还包含其部分块。OpenAI 提示词列表在 Decode "
+"上展开为子请求；代理收集所有子请求的会合元数据，并将原始列表一次性分发给 Prefill。"
+
+msgid "### Layer transfer"
+msgstr "### 层传输"
+
+msgid ""
+"After a layer's KV scatter completes, Prefill records an NPU event and queues a\n"
+"send task. The background sender waits for the event, publishes MemFabric\n"
+"metadata once per connection, and sends a readiness message."
+msgstr ""
+"在一层的 KV 分散完成后，Prefill 记录一个 NPU 事件并排队一个发送任务。后台发送器等待该事件，每个连接发布一次 MemFabric "
+"元数据，并发送就绪消息。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Decode validates the source and destination layouts, builds descriptors across\n"
+"the ready requests, and executes one synchronous batched MemFabric read. It\n"
+"then replies with success or failure for that layer."
+msgstr "Decode 验证源端和目标端布局，跨就绪请求构建描述符，并执行一次同步批量的 MemFabric 读取。然后它针对该层回复成功或失败。"
+
+msgid "## Control Protocol"
+msgstr "## 控制协议"
+
+msgid ""
+"Prefill uses ZMQ DEALER sockets. Each Decode TP rank owns one ZMQ ROUTER. Wire\n"
+"messages are positional msgpack tuples."
+msgstr ""
+"Prefill 使用 ZMQ DEALER 套接字。每个 Decode TP rank 拥有一个 ZMQ ROUTER。线协议消息是位置化的 "
+"msgpack 元组。"
+
+msgid "### MemFabric metadata"
+msgstr "### MemFabric 元数据"
+
+msgid "Prefill sends this once per connection before any readiness message:"
+msgstr "Prefill 在每个连接上、在任何就绪消息之前发送一次此消息："
+
+msgid ""
+"Layer metadata contains tensor group IDs, base addresses, block byte lengths,\n"
+"block-size scales, the number of main tensors, and indexer presence. Decode\n"
+"stores it by ZMQ identity and replies with `ACK`."
+msgstr ""
+"层元数据包含张量组 ID、基地址、块字节长度、块大小缩放、主张量数量以及索引器是否存在。Decode 按 ZMQ 身份存储该元数据并回复 `ACK`。"
+
+msgid "### Layer readiness"
+msgstr "### 层就绪"
+
+msgid "Prefill sends one message per layer and Decode endpoint:"
+msgstr "Prefill 为每一层和每个 Decode 端点发送一条消息："
+
+msgid ""
+"Each `read_reqs` entry contains the external request ID, Prefill main and\n"
+"indexer block IDs, and the main and indexer destination start offsets."
+msgstr "每个 `read_reqs` 条目包含外部请求 ID、Prefill 主块 ID 和索引器块 ID，以及主目标和索引器目标起始偏移量。"
+
+msgid ""
+"`done_ext_ids` identifies requests whose final chunk reached the last\n"
+"cache-bearing layer."
+msgstr "`done_ext_ids` 标识最终分块已到达最后一个承载缓存的层的请求。"
+
+msgid "### Completion reply"
+msgstr "### 完成回复"
+
+msgid ""
+"Protocol extensions append tuple fields. Receivers use tuple-length guards so\n"
+"missing unequal-TP fields retain legacy `ratio=1` behavior."
+msgstr "协议扩展会追加元组字段。接收方使用元组长度保护，因此缺失的不等 TP 字段保留旧版 `ratio=1` 行为。"
+
+msgid "## Correctness Invariants"
+msgstr "## 正确性不变量"
+
+msgid "### Physical-storage completion"
+msgstr "### 物理存储完成"
+
+msgid ""
+"Layerwise Prefill may reuse one physical buffer for multiple logical layers.\n"
+"Before a buffer is overwritten, every Decode endpoint that received readiness\n"
+"for the previous owner must acknowledge its read."
+msgstr ""
+"分层 Prefill 可能为多个逻辑层重用同一个物理缓冲区。在缓冲区被覆盖之前，每个收到前一个所有者就绪状态的 Decode 端点必须确认其读取完成。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Prefill therefore maintains one completion event per physical main or indexer\n"
+"storage slot, inferred from storage addresses rather than layer names. Main and\n"
+"indexer slots are tracked independently. Every readiness message receives a\n"
+"reply, including when a Decode rank owns zero blocks, so buffer reuse cannot\n"
+"deadlock on a missing no-op acknowledgement."
+msgstr ""
+"因此，Prefill "
+"为每个物理主存储槽或索引器存储槽维护一个完成事件，该事件根据存储地址而非层名称推断。主槽和索引器槽独立跟踪。每条就绪消息都会收到回复，包括当 "
+"Decode rank 拥有零个块时，因此缓冲区重用不会因缺少空操作确认而死锁。"
+
+msgid "### Request completion"
+msgstr "### 请求完成"
+
+msgid "Decode may schedule a request only after:"
+msgstr "Decode 仅在以下条件满足后才能调度请求："
+
+msgid ""
+"1. every Prefill contributor mapped to that Decode rank reports final-layer\n"
+"   completion; and\n"
+"2. every Decode TP rank reaches a terminal success or failure state."
+msgstr ""
+"1. 映射到该 Decode rank 的每个 Prefill 贡献者报告最终层完成；并且\n"
+"2. 每个 Decode TP rank 达到终态成功或失败状态。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Contributor state is keyed by external request ID. The worker gathers terminal\n"
+"state through the TP CPU group and maps the external ID back to the internal\n"
+"vLLM request ID."
+msgstr "贡献者状态以外部请求ID为键。工作进程通过TP CPU组收集终止状态，并将外部ID映射回内部vLLM请求ID。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Physical-storage completion and request completion remain independent. The\n"
+"first protects Prefill memory reuse; the second controls Decode scheduling."
+msgstr "物理存储完成与请求完成保持独立。前者保护Prefill内存复用；后者控制Decode调度。"
+
+msgid "### Layout validation"
+msgstr "### 布局验证"
+
+msgid ""
+"Before reading, Decode validates main tensor count and byte lengths, indexer\n"
+"presence and byte lengths, LIC8 scale presence and layout, and destination\n"
+"block ranges. Main, indexer, or scale mismatches fail the layer instead of\n"
+"leaving partially updated destination data."
+msgstr ""
+"在读取之前，Decode验证主张量数量和字节长度、索引器的存在性和字节长度、LIC8缩放因子的存在性和布局，以及目标块范围。主张量、索引器或缩放因子的不匹配会导致该层失败，而不是留下部分更新的目标数据。"
+
+msgid "## Unequal Prefill and Decode TP"
+msgstr "## 不等的Prefill和Decode TP"
+
+msgid "The supported topology is:"
+msgstr "支持的拓扑结构为："
+
+msgid "For Prefill rank `p_rank`:"
+msgstr "对于Prefill秩 `p_rank`："
+
+msgid ""
+"The `ratio` Prefill ranks mapped to one Decode rank form a contributor "
+"group:"
+msgstr "映射到一个Decode秩的`ratio`个Prefill秩构成一个贡献者组："
+
+msgid ""
+"- Main KV is replicated on Prefill. Only contributor member `0` pulls that\n"
+"  Decode rank's main share, preventing duplicate writes and excess bandwidth.\n"
+"- Each Decode rank needs a complete indexer. Contributors transfer disjoint\n"
+"  indexer ranges whose union is the complete copy. LIC8 scale follows the same\n"
+"  range.\n"
+"- A contributor with no blocks still acknowledges the layer and contributes\n"
+"  to request completion.\n"
+"- Duplicate final-layer signals from one contributor do not advance\n"
+"  completion."
+msgstr ""
+"- 主KV在Prefill上复制。只有贡献者成员`0`拉取该Decode秩的主份额，防止重复写入和多余带宽。\n"
+"- 每个Decode秩需要完整的索引器。贡献者传输不相交的索引器范围，其并集为完整副本。LIC8缩放因子遵循相同范围。\n"
+"- 没有块的贡献者仍然确认该层并参与请求完成。\n"
+"- 来自同一贡献者的重复最终层信号不会推进完成。"
+
+msgid "## AscendMultiConnector Integration"
+msgstr "## AscendMultiConnector集成"
+
+msgid ""
+"When RD2H is composed with AscendStore Layerwise Prefill offload, the RD2H\n"
+"completion provider runs first for:"
+msgstr "当RD2H与AscendStore逐层Prefill卸载组合时，RD2H完成提供者首先运行于："
+
+msgid ""
+"- `wait_for_layer_load`;\n"
+"- `save_kv_layer`; and\n"
+"- `on_kv_cache_written`."
+msgstr ""
+"- `wait_for_layer_load`；\n"
+"- `save_kv_layer`；以及\n"
+"- `on_kv_cache_written`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This ordering closes the RD2H storage-reuse gate before AscendStore publishes\n"
+"or reuses the same physical buffer. RD2H exposes `wait_for_layer_send` as the\n"
+"waiter used by the layerwise Prefill path."
+msgstr ""
+"此顺序在AscendStore发布或复用同一物理缓冲区之前关闭RD2H存储复用门。RD2H将`wait_for_layer_send`暴露为逐层Prefill路径使用的等待器。"
+
+msgid ""
+"On the scheduler side, RD2H must observe complete block groups even when\n"
+"another connector is selected for lookup. The\n"
+"`requires_full_blocks_on_update_after_alloc` flag preserves that behavior."
+msgstr ""
+"在调度器侧，即使选择了另一个连接器进行查找，RD2H也必须观察到完整的块组。`requires_full_blocks_on_update_after_alloc`标志保留了该行为。"
+
+msgid "## Ports and Endpoint Identity"
+msgstr "## 端口和端点标识"
+
+msgid "Only Decode binds connector control sockets:"
+msgstr "只有Decode绑定连接器控制套接字："
+
+msgid ""
+"The global DP rank, rather than a host-local rank, prevents port reuse across\n"
+"engines. Decode advertises the base port through the metaserver; Prefill adds\n"
+"the mapped Decode TP rank. Both the highest Decode TP port and the final mapped\n"
+"remote port are validated."
+msgstr ""
+"全局DP秩（而非主机本地秩）防止跨引擎的端口复用。Decode通过元服务器通告基础端口；Prefill添加映射的Decode TP秩。最高Decode "
+"TP端口和最终映射的远程端口均被验证。"
+
+msgid "## Failure and Compatibility"
+msgstr "## 故障与兼容性"
+
+msgid ""
+"- Metaserver transport errors are retried. HTTP error responses are treated as\n"
+"  delivered for compatibility with older proxy behavior.\n"
+"- A non-zero MemFabric read result becomes `READ_FAILED`. Decode marks the\n"
+"  request failed and its destination blocks invalid.\n"
+"- Prefill records the layer error and releases the affected storage events so\n"
+"  the compute path raises instead of deadlocking.\n"
+"- Data reads are not retried at the connector layer.\n"
+"- Prefill and Decode must use compatible protocol and cache-layout versions.\n"
+"  Mixing legacy and unequal-TP contributor builds can duplicate writes.\n"
+"- The process-wide MemFabric engine is bound to one role, device, and hostname."
+msgstr ""
+"- 元服务器传输错误会重试。HTTP错误响应被视为已送达，以兼容旧版代理行为。\n"
+"- 非零的MemFabric读取结果变为`READ_FAILED`。Decode将请求标记为失败，并将其目标块标记为无效。\n"
+"- Prefill记录层错误并释放受影响的存储事件，使计算路径抛出异常而不是死锁。\n"
+"- 连接器层不重试数据读取。\n"
+"- Prefill和Decode必须使用兼容的协议和缓存布局版本。混合使用旧版和不平等TP贡献者构建可能导致重复写入。\n"
+"- 进程级MemFabric引擎绑定到一个角色、设备和主机名。"
+
+msgid "## Implementation and Tests"
+msgstr "## 实现与测试"
+
+msgid ""
+"The implementation is under\n"
+"`vllm_ascend/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_p2p/sfa_pd_rd2h/`. Its primary tests\n"
+"are `test_sfa_pd_rd2h_connector.py`, `test_memfabric_transfer_engine.py`, and\n"
+"`test_ascend_multi_connector.py` under `tests/ut/kv_offload/`."
+msgstr ""
+"实现位于\n"
+"`vllm_ascend/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_p2p/sfa_pd_rd2h/`。其主要测试为\n"
+"`tests/ut/kv_offload/`下的`test_sfa_pd_rd2h_connector.py`、`test_memfabric_transfer_engine.py`和\n"
+"`test_ascend_multi_connector.py`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Use `tools/test_memfabric_pd_read.py` to validate real two-endpoint MemFabric\n"
+"registration and reads independently of vLLM scheduling."
+msgstr "使用`tools/test_memfabric_pd_read.py`独立于vLLM调度验证真实双端点MemFabric注册和读取。"
+
+msgid "## Current Limitations"
+msgstr "## 当前限制"
+
+msgid ""
+"- MemFabric is the only supported transfer backend.\n"
+"- Decode sparse offload supports TP but not CP or PP.\n"
+"- Prefill TP must be greater than or equal to, and divisible by, Decode TP.\n"
+"- Connector-level data-read retry is not implemented."
+msgstr ""
+"- MemFabric是唯一支持的传输后端。\n"

+"- Prefill TP必须大于或等于Decode TP，且能被其整除。\n"
+"- 未实现连接器级数据读取重试。"

+# SOME DESCRIPTIVE TITLE.
+# Copyright (C) 2026, vllm-ascend team
+# This file is distributed under the same license as the vllm-ascend package.
+# FIRST AUTHOR <EMAIL@ADDRESS>, 2026.
+#
+msgid ""
+msgstr ""
+"Project-Id-Version: vllm-ascend\n"
+"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To: \n"
+"POT-Creation-Date: 2026-08-13 02:44+0000\n"
+"PO-Revision-Date: 2026-08-13 02:44+0000\n"
+"Last-Translator: \n"
+"Language-Team: zh_CN <LL@li.org>\n"
+"Language: zh_CN\n"
+"MIME-Version: 1.0\n"
+"Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\n"
+"Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit\n"
+"Plural-Forms: nplurals=1; plural=0;\n"
+"Generated-By: detect_po_changes.py\n"
+
+msgid "# DyntraLB: Dynamic Intra-Decoder Data-Parallel Load Balancing"
+msgstr "# DyntraLB：解码器内部数据并行动态负载均衡"
+
+msgid ""
+"DyntraLB is a load-aware scheduler for data-parallel Decode nodes in a\n"
+"prefill/decode (P/D) disaggregated deployment. It reduces the time that lightly\n"
+"loaded DP ranks spend waiting for the busiest rank when request lengths are\n"
+"uneven."
+msgstr ""
+"DyntraLB 是面向预填充/解码（P/D）分离部署中数据并行 Decode 节点的负载感知调度器。当请求长度不均匀时，它可以减少负载较轻的 DP "
+"秩等待最繁忙秩的时间。"
+
+msgid ""
+"DyntraLB does not move requests between DP ranks. Instead, every DP rank shares a\n"
+"snapshot of its running and admissible waiting requests. The planner estimates\n"
+"each request's load from its KV-cache block count and tells each rank which\n"
+"local requests to admit, keep running, or pause. A request paused by DyntraLB\n"
+"keeps its allocated KV cache and can be resumed by the same rank later."
+msgstr ""
+"DyntraLB 不会在 DP 秩之间移动请求。相反，每个 DP 秩共享其运行中及可接纳的等待请求的快照。规划器根据请求的 KV "
+"缓存块数量估算每个请求的负载，并告知每个秩应接纳、继续运行或暂停哪些本地请求。被 DyntraLB 暂停的请求会保留其已分配的 KV "
+"缓存，并可在之后由同一秩恢复运行。"
+
+msgid "## When to use it"
+msgstr "## 何时使用"
+
+msgid "Consider enabling DyntraLB when all of the following are true:"
+msgstr "当以下所有条件均满足时，可考虑启用 DyntraLB："
+
+msgid ""
+"- the deployment uses P/D disaggregation\n"
+"- the Decode instance uses internal data parallelism on a single node\n"
+"- request lengths are skewed enough to create visible DP bubbles\n"
+"- Decode throughput is more important than preserving strict local request\n"
+"  execution order"
+msgstr ""
+"- 部署采用 P/D 分离架构\n"
+"- Decode 实例在单节点上使用内部数据并行\n"
+"- 请求长度分布不均，足以产生明显的 DP 气泡\n"
+"- Decode 吞吐量比保持严格的本地请求执行顺序更重要"
+
+msgid ""
+"Keep it disabled for a uniformly sized workload, a single-DP-rank Decode\n"
+"instance, or a multi-node Decode DP instance."
+msgstr "对于负载大小均匀的工作负载、单 DP 秩的 Decode 实例或多节点 Decode DP 实例，请保持其禁用状态。"
+
+msgid "## Requirements"
+msgstr "## 前提条件"
+
+msgid "DyntraLB has the following startup requirements:"
+msgstr "DyntraLB 有以下启动要求："
+
+msgid ""
+"- it must be enabled only on a P/D-disaggregated Decode node with\n"
+"  `kv_role=\"kv_consumer\"`\n"
+"- `data_parallel_size` must be greater than `1`\n"
+"- all DP ranks of the Decode instance must be on one node"
+msgstr ""
+"- 只能在设置了 `kv_role=\"kv_consumer\"` 的 P/D 分离 Decode 节点上启用\n"
+"- `data_parallel_size` 必须大于 `1`\n"
+"- Decode 实例的所有 DP 秩必须位于同一节点上"
+
+msgid ""
+"Configure DyntraLB only on Decode nodes. Do not add `dyntra_lb_config` with\n"
+"`enabled=true` to Prefill nodes."
+msgstr ""
+"仅在 Decode 节点上配置 DyntraLB。请勿在 Prefill 节点上添加 `enabled=true` 的 "
+"`dyntra_lb_config`。"
+
+msgid "DyntraLB cannot be combined with:"
+msgstr "DyntraLB 不能与以下配置组合使用："
+
+msgid ""
+"- `scheduler_config.enable_balance_scheduling`\n"
+"- `scheduler_config.profiling_chunk_config.enabled`"
+msgstr ""
+"- `scheduler_config.enable_balance_scheduling`\n"
+"- `scheduler_config.profiling_chunk_config.enabled`"
+
+msgid "The service rejects these unsupported combinations during startup."
+msgstr "服务会在启动期间拒绝这些不支持的组合。"
+
+msgid "## Configuration"
+msgstr "## 配置"
+
+msgid ""
+"Add `dyntra_lb_config` under `scheduler_config` in the Decode node's\n"
+"`--additional-config`."
+msgstr ""
+"在 Decode 节点的 `--additional-config` 中，将 `dyntra_lb_config` 添加到 "
+"`scheduler_config` 下。"
+
+msgid ""
+"DyntraLB and recompute scheduling remain independent sibling configurations.\n"
+"When both `dyntra_lb_config.enabled` and `recompute_scheduler_enable` are `true`,\n"
+"the Decode node uses the combined DyntraLB recompute scheduler."
+msgstr ""
+"DyntraLB 和重计算调度仍然是相互独立的同级配置。当 `dyntra_lb_config.enabled` 和 "
+"`recompute_scheduler_enable` 均为 `true` 时，Decode 节点将使用组合的 DyntraLB 重计算调度器。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Add the following arguments to an existing, working single-node Decode command.\n"
+"This fragment enables dynamic mode by default, which is recommended for production scenario:"
+msgstr "将以下参数添加到现有的、可正常工作的单节点 Decode 命令中。此片段默认启用动态模式，该模式推荐用于生产场景："
+
+msgid ""
+"Keep the existing `--kv-transfer-config` for the Decode node and verify that it\n"
+"sets `kv_role` to `kv_consumer`."
+msgstr ""
+"保留 Decode 节点现有的 `--kv-transfer-config`，并确认其将 `kv_role` 设置为 `kv_consumer`。"
+
+msgid "### Parameters"
+msgstr "### 参数"
+
+msgid "| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |"
+msgstr "| 参数 | 类型 | 默认值 | 描述 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `enabled` | bool | `false` | Enables DyntraLB and selects "
+"`DyntraLBScheduler` on the Decode node. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| `enabled` | bool | `false` | 启用 DyntraLB 并在 Decode 节点上选择 "
+"`DyntraLBScheduler`。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `mode` | str | `\"dynamic\"` | Selects `\"static\"` or `\"dynamic\"` "
+"activation. Use `\"static\"` only for troubleshooting; use `\"dynamic\"` for"
+" production scenarios. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| `mode` | str | `\"dynamic\"` | 选择 `\"static\"` 或 `\"dynamic\"` "
+"激活模式。仅在进行故障排查时使用 `\"static\"`；生产场景请使用 `\"dynamic\"`。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `start_step` | int | `250` | First completed engine-step snapshot from "
+"which DyntraLB can generate a plan for the next step. Must be greater than "
+"or equal to `0`. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| `start_step` | int | `250` | DyntraLB 可据此为下一步生成计划的第一个已完成引擎步快照。必须大于或等于 `0`。"
+" |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `end_step` | int | `-1` | Exclusive final snapshot step. `-1` means no "
+"final step. Otherwise, it must be greater than `start_step`. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| `end_step` | int | `-1` | 排他性的最终快照步。`-1` 表示没有最终步。否则，它必须大于 `start_step`。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `bubble_threshold` | float | `5.0` | Minimum imbalance that triggers "
+"planner modifications. Values greater than or equal to `1` are interpreted "
+"as an absolute KV-block difference between the maximum and average rank "
+"load. Values below `1` are interpreted as the normalized ratio `(maximum - "
+"average) / maximum`. Therefore, `1` means one KV-cache block, not 100%. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| `bubble_threshold` | float | `5.0` | 触发规划器修改的最小不均衡度。大于或等于 `1` "
+"的值被解释为最大秩负载与平均秩负载之间的绝对 KV 块差值。小于 `1` 的值被解释为归一化比率 `(最大值 - 平均值) / 最大值`。因此，`1` "
+"表示一个 KV 缓存块，而非 100%。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `long_req_block_threshold` | int | `700` | In dynamic mode, a newly added "
+"request with more than this number of KV-cache blocks activates balancing. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| `long_req_block_threshold` | int | `700` | 在动态模式下，新添加的请求若拥有超过此数量的 KV "
+"缓存块，将激活负载均衡。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `dynamic_max_step` | int | `256` | In dynamic mode, disables balancing "
+"after this many active steps without another newly added long request. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| `dynamic_max_step` | int | `256` | 在动态模式下，若在此数量的活动步内没有新添加的长请求，则禁用负载均衡。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `enable_diagnostics` | bool | `false` | Enable verbose logs for feature "
+"validation and debugging only. It is disabled by default and should remain "
+"disabled in production.  |"
+msgstr ""
+"| `enable_diagnostics` | bool | `false` | 仅用于功能验证和调试的详细日志。默认禁用，生产环境中应保持禁用。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"`long_req_block_threshold` and an absolute `bubble_threshold` are expressed in\n"
+"KV-cache blocks, not tokens. Their token equivalents therefore depend on the\n"
+"configured block size."
+msgstr ""
+"`long_req_block_threshold` 和绝对 `bubble_threshold` 以 KV 缓存块为单位表示，而非 "
+"token。因此，它们对应的 token 数量取决于配置的块大小。"
+
+msgid "## Static and dynamic modes"
+msgstr "## 静态与动态模式"
+
+msgid "### Static mode"
+msgstr "### 静态模式"
+
+msgid ""
+"Static mode evaluates the DP load on every coordinated engine step in the\n"
+"configured interval:"
+msgstr "静态模式在配置的区间内，对每个协调的引擎步评估 DP 负载："
+
+msgid ""
+"Static mode is intended only for troubleshooting and short validation runs. It\n"
+"keeps load balancing active throughout the configured interval, which makes\n"
+"DyntraLB behavior easier to observe. Do not use static mode for production.\n"
+"Set `start_step` to `0` during a short diagnostic run so that the run actually\n"
+"exercises DyntraLB."
+msgstr ""
+"静态模式仅用于故障排查和短期验证运行。它会在整个配置区间内保持负载均衡处于活动状态，从而使 DyntraLB "
+"的行为更易于观察。请勿在生产环境中使用静态模式。在进行短期诊断运行时，将 `start_step` 设置为 `0`，以便该运行实际执行 "
+"DyntraLB。"
+
+msgid "### Dynamic mode"
+msgstr "### 动态模式"
+
+msgid ""
+"Dynamic mode remains inactive until a newly added request exceeds\n"
+"`long_req_block_threshold`. It then evaluates load until\n"
+"`dynamic_max_step` consecutive active steps pass without another newly added\n"
+"long request:"
+msgstr ""
+"动态模式保持非活动状态，直到新添加的请求超过 `long_req_block_threshold`。随后，它会持续评估负载，直到连续 "
+"`dynamic_max_step` 个活动步内没有新添加的长请求为止："
+
+msgid ""
+"Dynamic mode is recommended for production because it activates load\n"
+"balancing only when a long request indicates that DP imbalance is likely. The\n"
+"`start_step` and `end_step` interval still applies in dynamic mode."
+msgstr ""
+"动态模式推荐用于生产环境，因为它仅在长请求表明可能出现 DP 不均衡时才激活负载均衡。`start_step` 和 `end_step` "
+"区间在动态模式下仍然适用。"
+
+msgid "## How scheduling works"
+msgstr "## 调度工作原理"
+
+msgid ""
+"DyntraLB pipelines each load-balancing decision across two engine steps:"
+msgstr "DyntraLB 将每个负载均衡决策跨两个引擎步进行流水线处理："
+
+msgid ""
+"1. the current step runs scheduling and model execution\n"
+"2. all DP ranks synchronize their wave/idle state\n"
+"3. each active rank prepares the local waiting requests whose remote KV cache\n"
+"   is ready\n"
+"4. the ranks all-gather the KV-block counts of running and admissible waiting\n"
+"   requests across the Decode DP group\n"
+"5. the planner generates a per-rank plan that can pause local running requests,\n"
+"   admit selected local waiting requests, or freeze new admission\n"
+"6. the next engine step applies that plan before normal scheduling and model\n"
+"   execution"
+msgstr ""
+"1. 当前步骤执行调度和模型推理\n"
+"2. 所有DP rank同步其wave/空闲状态\n"
+"3. 每个活跃rank准备本地等待请求，这些请求的远端KV缓存已就绪\n"
+"4. 各rank在Decode DP组内对运行中和可接纳等待请求的KV块数量执行all-gather\n"
+"5. 规划器生成按rank划分的计划，可暂停本地运行中的请求、接纳选定的本地等待请求，或冻结新的接纳\n"
+"6. 下一个引擎步骤在正常调度和模型推理之前应用该计划"
+
+msgid ""
+"The first engine step of a new wave has no plan from a preceding active step and\n"
+"therefore follows the normal scheduler path. In dynamic mode, detecting a new\n"
+"long request after that step immediately generates a plan for the following\n"
+"step. `start_step` and `end_step` select the completed-step snapshots from which\n"
+"plans may be generated; each generated plan is consumed by the next step."
+msgstr ""
+"新wave的第一个引擎步骤没有来自前一个活跃步骤的计划，因此遵循正常的调度路径。在动态模式下，该步骤之后检测到新的长请求会立即为下一步生成计划。`start_step`和`end_step`选择已完成的步骤快照，从中可以生成计划；每个生成的计划由下一步消费。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The planner uses request block counts as a lightweight load estimate. The\n"
+"estimate is intended to reduce DP bubbles; it is not a latency or throughput\n"
+"guarantee for every model and traffic distribution."
+msgstr "规划器使用请求块数量作为轻量级负载估计。该估计旨在减少DP气泡；它并不保证每种模型和流量分布下的延迟或吞吐量。"
+
+msgid "## Tuning and validation"
+msgstr "## 调优与验证"
+
+msgid ""
+"Start with a controlled A/B comparison using the same model, prompts, sampling\n"
+"parameters, concurrency, and P/D topology."
+msgstr "从受控的A/B对比开始，使用相同的模型、提示词、采样参数、并发度和P/D拓扑。"
+
+msgid ""
+"1. Set `start_step=0`, `mode=\"static\"`, and\n"
+"   `enable_diagnostics=true` for a short troubleshooting or functional run.\n"
+"2. Confirm that every Decode rank enters the same workload-collection steps\n"
+"   and that requests complete without persistent KV-waiting states.\n"
+"3. Compare throughput and latency with DyntraLB disabled.\n"
+"4. Turn diagnostics off for performance measurement.\n"
+"5. Switch to `mode=\"dynamic\"` for workload testing. Tune `bubble_threshold`,\n"
+"   `long_req_block_threshold`, and `dynamic_max_step` from the observed request\n"
+"   block-count distribution."
+msgstr ""
+"1. 设置`start_step=0`、`mode=\"static\"`和\n"
+"   `enable_diagnostics=true`进行简短的故障排查或功能验证运行。\n"
+"2. 确认每个Decode rank进入相同的工作负载收集步骤，并且请求在无持续KV等待状态下完成。\n"
+"3. 在禁用DyntraLB的情况下比较吞吐量和延迟。\n"
+"4. 关闭诊断以进行性能测量。\n"
+"5. 切换到`mode=\"dynamic\"`进行工作负载测试。根据观察到的请求块数量分布调整`bubble_threshold`、`long_req_block_threshold`和`dynamic_max_step`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"A very small `bubble_threshold` can cause frequent request pausing and\n"
+"admission changes. A very large value makes DyntraLB rarely modify the normal\n"
+"scheduler plan."
+msgstr "非常小的`bubble_threshold`可能导致频繁的请求暂停和接纳变更。非常大的值会使DyntraLB很少修改正常的调度计划。"
+
+msgid "## Diagnostics"
+msgstr "## 诊断"
+
+msgid ""
+"Set `enable_diagnostics=true` only while validating or troubleshooting:"
+msgstr "仅在验证或故障排查时设置`enable_diagnostics=true`："
+
+msgid ""
+"Rank 0 prints `[dyntra_lb]` workload snapshots and the generated `Out`, `In`, and\n"
+"`Freeze` modifications. Scheduler summaries and engine-step diagnostics are\n"
+"also emitted. These logs can be verbose and should normally remain disabled in\n"
+"throughput benchmarks."
+msgstr ""
+"Rank "
+"0打印`[dyntra_lb]`工作负载快照以及生成的`Out`、`In`和`Freeze`修改。同时也会输出调度器摘要和引擎步骤诊断。这些日志可能非常冗长，在吞吐量基准测试中通常应保持禁用。"
+
+msgid "## Limitations"
+msgstr "## 限制"
+
+msgid ""
+"- Only single-node, internally data-parallel Decode instances are supported.\n"
+"- DyntraLB does not route or migrate a request to another DP rank.\n"
+"- The planner estimates work from KV-cache blocks and uses a fixed throughput\n"
+"  heuristic. Model-specific costs, speculative-draft work, and operator-level\n"
+"  variation may require workload-specific tuning.\n"
+"- Combinations with speculative decoding or async scheduling should be\n"
+"  validated with the exact model, vLLM version, and vLLM Ascend version used in\n"
+"  production."
+msgstr ""
+"- 仅支持单节点、内部数据并行的Decode实例。\n"
+"- DyntraLB不会将请求路由或迁移到另一个DP rank。\n"
+"- 规划器根据KV缓存块估计工作量，并使用固定的吞吐量启发式算法。模型特定的成本、推测性草稿工作和算子级差异可能需要针对特定工作负载进行调优。\n"
+"- 与推测解码或异步调度组合使用时，应使用生产环境中使用的确切模型、vLLM版本和vLLM Ascend版本进行验证。"
+
+msgid ""
+"For the complete `additional_config` schema, see\n"
+"[Additional Configuration](../configuration/additional_config.md)."
+msgstr ""
+"有关完整的`additional_config`模式，请参阅\n"
+"[附加配置](../configuration/additional_config.md)。"

+# SOME DESCRIPTIVE TITLE.
+# Copyright (C) 2026, vllm-ascend team

+# FIRST AUTHOR <EMAIL@ADDRESS>, 2026.
+#
+msgid ""
+msgstr ""
+"Project-Id-Version: vllm-ascend\n"
+"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To: \n"
+"POT-Creation-Date: 2026-08-13 02:44+0000\n"
+"PO-Revision-Date: 2026-08-13 02:44+0000\n"
+"Last-Translator: \n"
+"Language-Team: zh_CN <LL@li.org>\n"
+"Language: zh_CN\n"
+"MIME-Version: 1.0\n"
+"Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\n"
+"Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit\n"
+"Plural-Forms: nplurals=1; plural=0;\n"
+"Generated-By: detect_po_changes.py\n"
+
+msgid "# Layerwise and Sparse KV Cache Offloading"
+msgstr "# 分层与稀疏KV缓存卸载"
+
+msgid "## 1. Background"
+msgstr "## 1. 背景"
+
+msgid ""
+"KV cache is a major NPU memory cost in long-sequence inference. Prefill and\n"
+"Decode have different performance characteristics, so they use different\n"
+"offloading strategies:"
+msgstr "KV缓存是长序列推理中NPU内存的主要开销。Prefill和Decode具有不同的性能特征，因此它们采用不同的卸载策略："
+
+msgid "| Stage | Feature | What remains on the NPU |"
+msgstr "| 阶段 | 特性 | NPU上保留的内容 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Prefill | Layerwise KV Cache Offload | A few reusable full-layer KV "
+"buffers |"
+msgstr "| Prefill | 分层KV缓存卸载 | 少量可复用的全层KV缓冲区 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Decode | Sparse KV Cache Offload | Indexer cache and a hot top-k KV buffer"
+" |"
+msgstr "| Decode | 稀疏KV缓存卸载 | 索引器缓存和热top-k KV缓冲区 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"Prefill has enough computation to overlap full-layer transfers. Decode does\n"
+"not, so it keeps the full KV cache in host memory and loads only the top-k\n"
+"entries needed by sparse attention."
+msgstr ""
+"Prefill有足够的计算量来重叠全层传输。Decode则不然，因此它将完整的KV缓存保留在主机内存中，仅加载稀疏注意力所需的top-k条目。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The design comes from\n"
+"[RFC #48203](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/48203). Its experiments\n"
+"show the potential to substantially increase sequence length or batch size, but\n"
+"actual results depend on the model, hardware, and configuration."
+msgstr ""
+"该设计源自\n"
+"[RFC #48203](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/48203)。其实验表明，该设计有潜力大幅增加序列长度或批处理大小，但实际结果取决于模型、硬件和配置。"
+
+msgid "## 2. Layerwise KV Cache Offload for Prefill"
+msgstr "## 2. Prefill的分层KV缓存卸载"
+
+msgid "### How it works"
+msgstr "### 工作原理"
+
+msgid ""
+"Layerwise Prefill KV Cache Offload maps many logical layers onto a smaller\n"
+"number of physical NPU buffers:"
+msgstr "分层Prefill KV缓存卸载将许多逻辑层映射到较少数量的物理NPU缓冲区上："
+
+msgid ""
+"1. load a layer's cached KV into a reusable buffer;\n"
+"2. run attention;\n"
+"3. save the updated KV to host memory; and\n"
+"4. reuse the buffer only after the save and any remote read complete."
+msgstr ""
+"1. 将层的缓存KV加载到可复用缓冲区中；\n"
+"2. 运行注意力；\n"
+"3. 将更新后的KV保存到主机内存；以及\n"
+"4. 仅在保存和任何远程读取完成后才复用缓冲区。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Multiple buffers allow transfer and computation to overlap. The current\n"
+"implementation uses `AscendStoreConnector` with the Memcache backend."
+msgstr "多个缓冲区允许传输和计算重叠。当前实现使用带有Memcache后端的`AscendStoreConnector`。"
+
+msgid "### Requirements"
+msgstr "### 要求"
+
+msgid ""
+"- Use a dedicated Prefill node with `kv_role: \"kv_producer\"`.\n"
+"- Use `backend: \"memcache\"` and `use_layerwise: true`.\n"
+"- Use an MLA, SFA, or DSA attention backend with eager execution.\n"
+"- Install MemFabric Hybrid first, then Memcache Hybrid on the Prefill node.\n"
+"  Memcache is the host KV Pool backend; MemFabric is its dependency.\n"
+"- Configure `mmc-meta.conf` and `mmc-local.conf`, and start MetaService before\n"
+"  starting Prefill."
+msgstr ""
+"- 使用带有`kv_role: \"kv_producer\"`的专用Prefill节点。\n"
+"- 使用`backend: \"memcache\"`和`use_layerwise: true`。\n"
+"- 使用MLA、SFA或DSA注意力后端并启用eager执行。\n"
+"- 在Prefill节点上先安装MemFabric Hybrid，然后安装Memcache Hybrid。\n"
+"  Memcache是主机KV池后端；MemFabric是其依赖项。\n"
+"- 配置`mmc-meta.conf`和`mmc-local.conf`，并在启动Prefill之前启动MetaService。"
+
+msgid "Build and install MemFabric Hybrid first:"
+msgstr "首先构建并安装MemFabric Hybrid："
+
+msgid ""
+"Then build and install Memcache Hybrid. Its MemFabric submodule must use the\n"
+"same `release/1.2` branch:"
+msgstr "然后构建并安装Memcache Hybrid。其MemFabric子模块必须使用相同的`release/1.2`分支："
+
+msgid "Prepare the host before starting Prefill:"
+msgstr "在启动Prefill之前准备主机："
+
+msgid ""
+"Configure `mmc-meta.conf` with the MetaService and Config Store endpoints:"
+msgstr "使用MetaService和Config Store端点配置`mmc-meta.conf`："
+
+msgid "Configure `mmc-local.conf` on each Prefill node:"
+msgstr "在每个Prefill节点上配置`mmc-local.conf`："
+
+msgid ""
+"The two files must use the same MetaService endpoint, and the LocalService\n"
+"Config Store endpoint must match the MetaService Config Store endpoint. Set\n"
+"`world_size` to the maximum number of LocalService instances in the deployment.\n"
+"Use `device_sdma` on A3 with HCCS, or `device_rdma` on A2 and other systems with\n"
+"device RoCE. Set `dram.size` to the host-memory capacity contributed by each\n"
+"LocalService."
+msgstr ""
+"这两个文件必须使用相同的MetaService端点，并且LocalService的Config Store端点必须与MetaService的Config"
+" "
+"Store端点匹配。将`world_size`设置为部署中LocalService实例的最大数量。在带有HCCS的A3上使用`device_sdma`，在A2和其他带有设备RoCE的系统上使用`device_rdma`。将`dram.size`设置为每个LocalService贡献的主机内存容量。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Export both configuration paths before starting Prefill, and start MetaService\n"
+"in a separate process:"
+msgstr "在启动Prefill之前导出两个配置路径，并在单独的进程中启动MetaService："
+
+msgid "### Configuration"
+msgstr "### 配置"
+
+msgid ""
+"To enable only Layerwise Prefill KV Cache Offload, add the following option to\n"
+"the Prefill launch command. This example keeps layer 0 independent and assigns\n"
+"all other layers to three reusable buffers:"
+msgstr ""
+"要仅启用分层Prefill KV缓存卸载，请在Prefill启动命令中添加以下选项。此示例将第0层保持独立，并将所有其他层分配给三个可复用缓冲区："
+
+msgid "| Parameter | Description |"
+msgstr "| 参数 | 描述 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `backend` | Host KV Pool backend. Shared-buffer layerwise offload requires"
+" `\"memcache\"`. |"
+msgstr "| `backend` | 主机KV池后端。共享缓冲区分层卸载需要`\"memcache\"`。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `use_layerwise` | Enables layer-by-layer KV transfer and reusable NPU "
+"buffers. |"
+msgstr "| `use_layerwise` | 启用逐层KV传输和可复用的NPU缓冲区。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `layerwise_num_shared_buffers` | Number of reusable NPU buffers. More "
+"buffers use more memory but provide more opportunity to overlap transfer and"
+" computation. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| `layerwise_num_shared_buffers` | 可复用NPU缓冲区的数量。更多缓冲区占用更多内存，但提供更多重叠传输和计算的机会。"
+" |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `layerwise_independent_layers` | Layers that keep dedicated buffers. The "
+"default is `[0]`; `\"all\"` disables cross-layer reuse. |"
+msgstr "| `layerwise_independent_layers` | 保留专用缓冲区的层。默认值为`[0]`；`\"all\"`禁用跨层复用。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"The buffer count is workload-dependent. Start with two to four buffers and tune\n"
+"it according to NPU memory and transfer bandwidth."
+msgstr "缓冲区数量取决于工作负载。从两到四个缓冲区开始，并根据NPU内存和传输带宽进行调整。"
+
+msgid ""
+"When Sparse KV Cache Offload is also enabled on Decode, replace this\n"
+"single-connector configuration with the Prefill `MultiConnector` configuration\n"
+"in [chapter 4](#4-use-them-together). `AscendStoreConnector` offloads each layer\n"
+"buffer to Memcache,\n"
+"while `SfaRemoteD2HConnector` exposes the same buffer for Decode to pull through\n"
+"MemFabric. A reusable buffer is released only after both operations complete."
+msgstr ""
+"当Decode上也启用了稀疏KV缓存卸载时，请将此单连接器配置替换为[第4章](#4-use-them-together)中的Prefill "
+"`MultiConnector`配置。`AscendStoreConnector`将每个层缓冲区卸载到Memcache，而`SfaRemoteD2HConnector`则暴露相同的缓冲区供Decode通过MemFabric拉取。可复用缓冲区仅在两个操作都完成后才释放。"
+
+msgid "### Verification and limitations"
+msgstr "### 验证与限制"
+
+msgid "The following log means buffer reuse is active:"
+msgstr "以下日志表示缓冲区复用已激活："
+
+msgid ""
+"- Shared-buffer offload currently requires Memcache and eager execution.\n"
+"- Context parallelism has not been validated.\n"
+"- AscendStore's own layerwise P/D transfer does not support TP mismatch. This\n"
+"  limitation does not apply when `SfaRemoteD2HConnector` performs P/D transfer.\n"
+"- MTP layers and optional SFA indexer caches participate in buffer reuse and\n"
+"  memory accounting automatically."
+msgstr ""
+"- 共享缓冲区卸载目前需要Memcache和eager执行。\n"
+"- 上下文并行尚未验证。\n"
+"- AscendStore自身的分层P/D传输不支持TP不匹配。当`SfaRemoteD2HConnector`执行P/D传输时，此限制不适用。\n"
+"- MTP层和可选的SFA索引器缓存会自动参与缓冲区复用和内存核算。"
+
+msgid "## 3. Sparse KV Cache Offload for Decode"
+msgstr "## 3. Decode的稀疏KV缓存卸载"
+
+msgid "### How it works"
+msgstr "### 工作原理"
+
+msgid ""
+"Sparse KV Cache Offload stores the full KV cache in host memory. The NPU "
+"keeps:"
+msgstr "稀疏KV缓存卸载将完整的KV缓存存储在主机内存中。NPU保留："
+
+msgid ""
+"- the indexer cache used to select important tokens; and\n"
+"- a hot buffer containing recently used top-k KV entries."
+msgstr ""
+"- 用于选择重要令牌的索引器缓存；以及\n"
+"- 包含最近使用的top-k KV条目的热缓冲区。"
+
+msgid ""
+"On each Decode step, entries already in the hot buffer are reused and only\n"
+"cache misses are loaded from host memory. `SfaRemoteD2HConnector` transfers the\n"
+"Prefill KV cache directly into the Decode-side storage."
+msgstr ""
+"在每个Decode步骤中，热缓冲区中已有的条目会被复用，仅从主机内存加载缓存未命中的条目。`SfaRemoteD2HConnector`将Prefill"
+" KV缓存直接传输到Decode端存储。"
+
+msgid "### Requirements"
+msgstr "### 要求"
+
+msgid ""
+"- Use a sparse-attention model such as\n"
+"  [GLM-5.2](https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-5.2) or\n"
+"  [DeepSeek-V3.2](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.2).\n"
+"- Use disaggregated P/D deployment and enable the feature only on Decode.\n"
+"- Tensor parallelism is supported; context and pipeline parallelism are not.\n"
+"- Model Runner V1 is required.\n"
+"- Install MemFabric Hybrid release 1.2. The current version requires NPU driver\n"
+"  `25.5.1` or later.\n"
+"- Install Clang and OpenMP if they are not already available in the image."
+msgstr ""
+"- 使用稀疏注意力模型，例如\n"
+"  [GLM-5.2](https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-5.2) 或\n"
+"  [DeepSeek-V3.2](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.2)。\n"
+"- 使用分离式 P/D 部署，并仅在 Decode 阶段启用该功能。\n"
+"- 支持张量并行；不支持上下文并行和流水线并行。\n"
+"- 需要 Model Runner V1。\n"
+"- 安装 MemFabric Hybrid 1.2 版本。当前版本需要 NPU 驱动\n"
+"  `25.5.1` 或更高版本。\n"
+"- 如果镜像中尚未提供 Clang 和 OpenMP，请安装它们。"
+
+msgid "If MemFabric Hybrid 1.2 is not already installed in the image:"
+msgstr "如果镜像中尚未安装 MemFabric Hybrid 1.2："
+
+msgid "Check whether Clang and OpenMP are available:"
+msgstr "检查 Clang 和 OpenMP 是否可用："
+
+msgid "If either dependency is missing, install it:"
+msgstr "如果缺少任一依赖项，请安装它："
+
+msgid ""
+"If the image already provides a specific Clang version but lacks OpenMP,\n"
+"install the matching package instead, for example `libomp-17-dev` for Clang 17."
+msgstr ""
+"如果镜像已提供特定版本的 Clang 但缺少 OpenMP，\n"
+"请安装匹配的软件包，例如针对 Clang 17 安装 `libomp-17-dev`。"
+
+msgid "### Configuration"
+msgstr "### 配置"
+
+msgid "Add the following options to the Decode launch command:"
+msgstr "将以下选项添加到 Decode 启动命令中："
+
+msgid "| Parameter | Description |"
+msgstr "| 参数 | 描述 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `topk_buffer_size` | Device hot-buffer size. It must be at least "
+"`index_topk` and divisible by `block_size`. Twice `index_topk` is a "
+"practical starting point. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| `topk_buffer_size` | 设备热缓冲区大小。它必须至少为 `index_topk`，并且能被 `block_size` 整除。以 "
+"`index_topk` 的两倍作为起点是可行的。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `dram_size_per_dp_GB` | Host memory reserved per DP rank. It must hold the"
+" full KV cache. TP ranks share this pool. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| `dram_size_per_dp_GB` | 每个 DP rank 预留的主机内存。它必须能容纳完整的 KV 缓存。TP rank 共享此内存池。"
+" |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `keep_device_kv_cache` | Debug-only option that retains the full device KV"
+" cache. Keep it `false` in production. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| `keep_device_kv_cache` | 仅用于调试的选项，用于保留完整的设备 KV 缓存。在生产环境中请保持其为 `false`。 |"
+
+msgid "## 4. Use Them Together"
+msgstr "## 4. 组合使用"
+
+msgid "The combined data flow is:"
+msgstr "组合后的数据流如下："
+
+msgid "### Prefill configuration"
+msgstr "### Prefill 配置"
+
+msgid ""
+"Add the following option to the Prefill launch command. `MultiConnector` lets\n"
+"Prefill save KV to Memcache and expose the same layer buffer to Decode:"
+msgstr ""
+"将以下选项添加到 Prefill 启动命令中。`MultiConnector` 允许\n"
+"Prefill 将 KV 保存到 Memcache，并将相同的层缓冲区暴露给 Decode："
+
+msgid ""
+"Do not enable `sparse_kv_offload_config` on Prefill. A reusable Prefill buffer\n"
+"is released only after AscendStore has saved it and Decode has completed the\n"
+"Remote D2H read."
+msgstr ""
+"不要在 Prefill 上启用 `sparse_kv_offload_config`。可复用的 Prefill 缓冲区\n"
+"只有在 AscendStore 保存它且 Decode 完成远程 D2H 读取后才会被释放。"
+
+msgid "### Decode configuration"
+msgstr "### Decode 配置"
+
+msgid ""
+"Use the Sparse KV Cache Offload configuration from chapter 3. Decode owns the\n"
+"destination and pulls main KV directly into its host pool; indexer KV remains\n"
+"in rank-local NPU memory."
+msgstr ""
+"使用第 3 章中的稀疏 KV 缓存卸载配置。Decode 拥有目标端，\n"
+"并将主 KV 直接拉取到其主机内存池中；索引器 KV 保留在\n"
+"rank 本地的 NPU 内存中。"
+
+msgid "### Proxy"
+msgstr "### 代理"
+
+msgid "Start the layerwise proxy after Prefill and Decode are ready:"
+msgstr "在 Prefill 和 Decode 就绪后启动逐层代理："
+
+msgid ""
+"Use reachable addresses for multi-node deployment. Do not advertise\n"
+"`0.0.0.0`, because Decode calls the proxy's `/v1/metaserver` endpoint. Send\n"
+"inference requests to the proxy port (`9000` in this example)."
+msgstr ""
+"在多节点部署中使用可访问的地址。不要通告\n"
+"`0.0.0.0`，因为 Decode 会调用代理的 `/v1/metaserver` 端点。将\n"
+"推理请求发送到代理端口（本例中为 `9000`）。"
+
+msgid "### Deployment checklist"
+msgstr "### 部署检查清单"
+
+msgid ""
+"- Set `transfer_backend` to `memfabric` on both Prefill and Decode.\n"
+"- Prefill TP must be greater than or equal to Decode TP and divisible by it.\n"
+"- `kv_port` is the Decode control-port base. Reserve\n"
+"  `decode_data_parallel_size * decode_tensor_parallel_size` consecutive ports.\n"
+"  Prefill does not bind these ports; Decode supplies the target through request\n"
+"  metadata."
+msgstr ""
+"- 在 Prefill 和 Decode 上都将 `transfer_backend` 设置为 `memfabric`。\n"
+"- Prefill 的 TP 必须大于或等于 Decode 的 TP，并且能被其整除。\n"
+"- `kv_port` 是 Decode 控制端口的基地址。预留\n"
+"  `decode_data_parallel_size * decode_tensor_parallel_size` 个连续端口。\n"
+"  Prefill 不绑定这些端口；Decode 通过请求元数据提供目标地址。"

+# SOME DESCRIPTIVE TITLE.
+# Copyright (C) 2026, vllm-ascend team

+# FIRST AUTHOR <EMAIL@ADDRESS>, 2026.
+#
+msgid ""
+msgstr ""
+"Project-Id-Version: vllm-ascend\n"
+"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To: \n"
+"POT-Creation-Date: 2026-08-13 02:44+0000\n"
+"PO-Revision-Date: 2026-08-13 02:44+0000\n"
+"Last-Translator: \n"
+"Language-Team: zh_CN <LL@li.org>\n"
+"Language: zh_CN\n"
+"MIME-Version: 1.0\n"
+"Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\n"
+"Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit\n"
+"Plural-Forms: nplurals=1; plural=0;\n"
+"Generated-By: detect_po_changes.py\n"
+
+msgid "# Pipeline Parallelism"
+msgstr "# 流水线并行"
+
+msgid ""
+"Pipeline Parallelism (PP) partitions a model's Transformer hidden layers into\n"
+"consecutive pipeline stages. Each stage is executed by one Tensor Parallel (TP)\n"
+"group, or by one worker when the TP size is `1`, and sends intermediate\n"
+"activations to the next stage. For example, `--pipeline-parallel-size 2`\n"
+"divides the hidden layers between two pipeline stages."
+msgstr ""
+"流水线并行（PP）将模型的 Transformer 隐藏层划分为连续的流水线阶段。每个阶段由一个张量并行（TP）组执行，当 TP 大小为 `1` "
+"时，则由单个 worker 执行，并将中间激活传递给下一阶段。例如，`--pipeline-parallel-size 2` "
+"将隐藏层划分为两个流水线阶段。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Input tokens → PP stage 0 (earlier hidden layers) → intermediate activations →\n"
+"PP stage 1 (later hidden layers, final norm, LM head, and sampling) → output\n"
+"tokens."
+msgstr ""
+"输入 token → PP 阶段 0（较早的隐藏层）→ 中间激活 → PP 阶段 1（较晚的隐藏层、最终归一化、LM 头及采样）→ 输出 token。"
+
+msgid "This guide uses the following terms:"
+msgstr "本指南使用以下术语："
+
+msgid "| Term | Meaning |"
+msgstr "| 术语 | 含义 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| PP stage | A logical partition containing a consecutive range of model "
+"layers. |"
+msgstr "| PP 阶段 | 包含连续模型层范围的一个逻辑分区。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| PP rank | A worker's stage index within its PP communication group. "
+"Workers with the same stage index and different TP ranks jointly execute one"
+" stage. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| PP rank | worker 在其 PP 通信组内的阶段索引。具有相同阶段索引和不同 TP rank 的 worker 共同执行一个阶段。 |"
+
+msgid "| TP group | The workers that apply TP together within one PP stage. |"
+msgstr "| TP 组 | 在一个 PP 阶段内共同应用 TP 的 worker。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Node | A physical server. One node can contain multiple PP stages or TP "
+"groups. |"
+msgstr "| 节点 | 一台物理服务器。一个节点可以包含多个 PP 阶段或 TP 组。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"Not every model implementation supports PP. Before deployment, check the\n"
+"    **Pipeline Parallel** column in [Supported Models](../support_matrix/supported_models.md)."
+msgstr ""
+"并非所有模型实现都支持 "
+"PP。部署前，请查看[支持的模型](../support_matrix/supported_models.md)中的**流水线并行**列。"
+
+msgid ""
+"For a first deployment, begin with **Quick Start**. Before production, review\n"
+"**Configure Layer Partitioning** and the compatibility limitations. Use the\n"
+"advanced scenarios and performance analysis when the deployment needs\n"
+"additional features or tuning."
+msgstr ""
+"首次部署时，请从**快速开始**入手。生产环境部署前，请审阅**配置层分区**及兼容性限制。当部署需要额外功能或调优时，可使用高级场景和性能分析。"
+
+msgid "## Quick Start"
+msgstr "## 快速开始"
+
+msgid ""
+"The following examples show the minimum options for starting a basic PP\n"
+"deployment. Review the topology, compatibility, and performance sections\n"
+"before using the configuration in production."
+msgstr "以下示例展示了启动基本 PP 部署所需的最少选项。在生产环境中使用该配置前，请审阅拓扑、兼容性和性能部分。"
+
+msgid "### Before You Begin"
+msgstr "### 开始之前"
+
+msgid "Verify the following before starting the service:"
+msgstr "启动服务前，请确认以下事项："
+
+msgid ""
+"- The visible NPU count satisfies the selected TP/PP/DP topology.\n"
+"- All nodes use the same vLLM, vLLM Ascend, model weights, and Python environment.\n"
+"- All nodes can access the same model path or equivalent local copies.\n"
+"- For an MP deployment, every node can reach the head node's master address\n"
+"  and port.\n"
+"- HCCL and, for a Ray deployment, the Ray resource view are healthy."
+msgstr ""
+"- 可见的 NPU 数量满足所选 TP/PP/DP 拓扑的要求。\n"
+"- 所有节点使用相同的 vLLM、vLLM Ascend、模型权重和 Python 环境。\n"
+"- 所有节点可以访问相同的模型路径或等效的本地副本。\n"
+"- 对于 MP 部署，每个节点都能访问头节点的 master 地址和端口。\n"
+"- HCCL 以及（对于 Ray 部署）Ray 资源视图均处于健康状态。"
+
+msgid "### Single-Node Deployment"
+msgstr "### 单节点部署"
+
+msgid ""
+"The following example demonstrates the minimum PP syntax on two NPUs. Use this\n"
+"topology only when layer partitioning is required:"
+msgstr "以下示例演示了在两个 NPU 上的最小 PP 语法。仅在需要层分区时使用此拓扑："
+
+msgid ""
+"Increase `--tensor-parallel-size` when each stage should use a TP group. For\n"
+"example, `TP4 PP2` requires eight visible NPUs."
+msgstr "当每个阶段应使用 TP 组时，请增大 `--tensor-parallel-size`。例如，`TP4 PP2` 需要八个可见的 NPU。"
+
+msgid "### Two-Node Deployment with Multiprocessing"
+msgstr "### 使用多进程的两节点部署"
+
+msgid ""
+"The multiprocessing (MP) backend can start a PP deployment across two nodes\n"
+"without a Ray cluster. The following example uses two 8-NPU nodes, keeps TP\n"
+"inside each node, and places one PP stage on each node. Replace\n"
+"`<HEAD_NODE_IP>` with an address that the worker node can reach and\n"
+"`<MASTER_PORT>` with an unused TCP port. Use the same values on both nodes."
+msgstr ""
+"多进程（MP）后端可以在没有 Ray 集群的情况下跨两个节点启动 PP 部署。以下示例使用两个 8-NPU 节点，将 TP "
+"保持在每个节点内部，并在每个节点上放置一个 PP 阶段。将 `<HEAD_NODE_IP>` 替换为 worker 节点可以访问的地址，将 "
+"`<MASTER_PORT>` 替换为未使用的 TCP 端口。两个节点上使用相同的值。"
+
+msgid "On the head node, use node rank `0`:"
+msgstr "在头节点上，使用节点 rank `0`："
+
+msgid "On the worker node, use node rank `1` and add `--headless`:"
+msgstr "在 worker 节点上，使用节点 rank `1` 并添加 `--headless`："
+
+msgid ""
+"Only the head node starts the API server. Both nodes must use identical model,\n"
+"TP, PP, `--nnodes`, `--master-addr`, and `--master-port` values. Assign each\n"
+"node a unique `--node-rank` from `0` to `--nnodes - 1`, and set the required\n"
+"HCCL and communication environment variables before running either command."
+msgstr ""
+"只有头节点启动 API 服务器。两个节点必须使用相同的模型、TP、PP、`--nnodes`、`--master-addr` 和 `--master-"
+"port` 值。为每个节点分配从 `0` 到 `--nnodes - 1` 的唯一 `--node-rank`，并在运行任一命令前设置所需的 HCCL "
+"和通信环境变量。"
+
+msgid "### Multi-Node Deployment with Ray"
+msgstr "### 使用 Ray 的多节点部署"
+
+msgid ""
+"After starting the Ray cluster, run `vllm serve` on the head node. For two\n"
+"8-NPU nodes, keep TP inside each node and use PP between the nodes:"
+msgstr ""
+"启动 Ray 集群后，在头节点上运行 `vllm serve`。对于两个 8-NPU 节点，将 TP 保持在每个节点内部，并在节点之间使用 PP："
+
+msgid ""
+"Start Ray only after setting the required communication environment variables\n"
+"on every node. The complete cluster setup is documented in\n"
+"[Ray Distributed](../../tutorials/features/ray.md)."
+msgstr ""
+"仅在每个节点上设置所需的通信环境变量后，再启动 Ray。完整的集群设置文档请参阅[Ray "
+"分布式](../../tutorials/features/ray.md)。"
+
+msgid "## When to Use PP"
+msgstr "## 何时使用 PP"
+
+msgid "PP is useful in the following situations:"
+msgstr "PP 在以下情况下很有用："
+
+msgid ""
+"- A model does not fit in one TP group and must be divided further by layer.\n"
+"- A multi-node deployment should keep high-frequency TP collectives inside each\n"
+"  node while sending activations between nodes through PP.\n"
+"- A Prefill node in a P/D-disaggregated deployment needs more devices for model\n"
+"  capacity or long-context prefill."
+msgstr ""
+"- 模型无法放入一个 TP 组，必须按层进一步划分。\n"
+"- 多节点部署应将高频 TP 集合通信保持在每个节点内部，同时通过 PP 在节点之间发送激活。\n"
+"- P/D 分离部署中的 Prefill 节点需要更多设备来满足模型容量或长上下文 prefill 的需求。"
+
+msgid ""
+"PP also introduces activation transfers between stages and pipeline bubbles.\n"
+"Use a TP-only deployment as the baseline when the model fits in one node, then\n"
+"add PP when model capacity or the network topology requires it."
+msgstr "PP 还会引入阶段间的激活传输和流水线气泡。当模型可以放入一个节点时，以仅 TP 部署为基线，然后在模型容量或网络拓扑需要时添加 PP。"
+
+msgid "| Deployment goal | Recommended starting point |"
+msgstr "| 部署目标 | 推荐起点 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| The model fits in one node | Start with TP only and benchmark before "
+"adding PP. |"
+msgstr "| 模型可放入一个节点 | 先仅使用 TP 并进行基准测试，然后再添加 PP。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| The model spans multiple nodes | Use TP within a node and PP across nodes."
+" |"
+msgstr "| 模型跨多个节点 | 在节点内使用 TP，在节点间使用 PP。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Multiple serving replicas are required | Build one TP/PP replica first, "
+"then add DP only on a supported model, operator, and network topology. |"
+msgstr "| 需要多个服务副本 | 先构建一个 TP/PP 副本，然后仅在支持的模型、算子和网络拓扑上添加 DP。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Long-context Prefill needs PP tuning | Start with PP, then evaluate "
+"[Dynamic Chunked Pipeline Parallel](dynamic_chunk_pipeline_parallel.md). |"
+msgstr ""
+"| 长上下文 Prefill 需要 PP 调优 | 从 PP "
+"开始，然后评估[动态分块流水线并行](dynamic_chunk_pipeline_parallel.md)。 |"
+
+msgid "## Configure Layer Partitioning"
+msgstr "## 配置层分区"
+
+msgid ""
+"Layer partitioning determines which range of target-model hidden layers each PP\n"
+"stage executes. If the target model has `N` hidden layers and the PP size is\n"
+"`P`, the stage selected by PP rank `i` uses a half-open interval:"
+msgstr ""
+"层分区决定每个 PP 阶段执行目标模型隐藏层的哪个范围。如果目标模型有 `N` 个隐藏层且 PP 大小为 `P`，则 PP rank `i` "
+"选择的阶段使用半开区间："
+
+msgid ""
+"Only the target model's Transformer hidden layers participate in this\n"
+"partitioning."
+msgstr "只有目标模型的 Transformer 隐藏层参与此分区。"
+
+msgid "### Automatic Partitioning"
+msgstr "### 自动分区"
+
+msgid ""
+"By default, vLLM distributes hidden layers as evenly as possible. When the layer\n"
+"count is not divisible by the PP size, vLLM assigns the remaining layers\n"
+"starting from the second-to-last stage and proceeding toward lower PP ranks.\n"
+"This avoids adding more hidden layers to the last stage, which normally also\n"
+"runs the final norm, LM head, logits, and sampling. With more than two stages,\n"
+"small remainders are placed on middle stages to reduce pressure on the input\n"
+"and output stages."
+msgstr ""
+"默认情况下，vLLM 会尽可能均匀地分配隐藏层。当层数不能被 PP 大小整除时，vLLM 会从倒数第二个阶段开始，向较低的 PP "
+"排名分配剩余的层。这样可以避免给最后一个阶段增加更多隐藏层，因为最后一个阶段通常还运行最终的归一化、LM 头、logits "
+"和采样。当阶段数超过两个时，较小的余数会放置在中间阶段，以减少输入和输出阶段的压力。"
+
+msgid "For a target model with 61 hidden layers:"
+msgstr "对于具有 61 个隐藏层的目标模型："
+
+msgid ""
+"Use automatic partitioning first. Customize it only when measurements show a\n"
+"stage-level memory or latency imbalance."
+msgstr "首先使用自动分区。仅在测量显示阶段级内存或延迟不平衡时，才进行自定义。"
+
+msgid "### Custom Partitioning"
+msgstr "### 自定义分区"
+
+msgid ""
+"Set `VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION` to the number of target hidden layers executed by\n"
+"each PP stage, in PP-rank order:"
+msgstr "将 `VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION` 设置为每个 PP 阶段执行的目标隐藏层数，按 PP 排名顺序排列："
+
+msgid "In this example:"
+msgstr "在此示例中："
+
+msgid "The partition must satisfy all of the following rules:"
+msgstr "分区必须满足以下所有规则："
+
+msgid ""
+"- Use one positive integer per PP rank, separated by commas.\n"
+"- The number of entries must equal `--pipeline-parallel-size`.\n"
+"- The sum must equal the target model's hidden-layer count.\n"
+"- Do not include embeddings, the final norm, the LM head, or draft-model layers.\n"
+"- Use the same value for every worker in one service instance.\n"
+"- On Ray clusters, set the value on every node before starting Ray.\n"
+"- Restart the service after changing the value."
+msgstr ""
+"- 每个 PP 排名使用一个正整数，用逗号分隔。\n"
+"- 条目数必须等于 `--pipeline-parallel-size`。\n"
+"- 总和必须等于目标模型的隐藏层数。\n"
+"- 不要包含嵌入、最终归一化、LM 头或草稿模型层。\n"
+"- 在一个服务实例中，所有 worker 必须使用相同的值。\n"
+"- 在 Ray 集群上，在启动 Ray 之前在每个节点上设置该值。\n"
+"- 更改值后重启服务。"
+
+msgid "An invalid entry count or layer sum causes startup to fail."
+msgstr "无效的条目数或层数总和会导致启动失败。"
+
+msgid "### Tune Stage Balance"
+msgstr "### 调整阶段平衡"
+
+msgid ""
+"Stage balance is workload-dependent. The last stage often needs extra memory\n"
+"and compute for the final norm, LM head, logits, sampling, and possibly a local\n"
+"speculative-decoding drafter."
+msgstr ""
+"阶段平衡取决于工作负载。最后一个阶段通常需要额外的内存和计算资源，用于最终的归一化、LM 头、logits、采样，以及可能的本地投机解码草稿模型。"
+
+msgid "Use the following tuning loop:"
+msgstr "使用以下调优循环："
+
+msgid ""
+"1. Start with automatic partitioning.\n"
+"2. Record peak memory and step latency for the workers in every PP stage under\n"
+"   a representative workload.\n"
+"3. If the last stage is the bottleneck, move one target hidden layer at a time\n"
+"   from the last stage to a preceding stage with a lower PP rank, for example\n"
+"   from `[31,30]` to `[32,29]`.\n"
+"4. Repeat the accuracy and performance test after every change."
+msgstr ""
+"1. 从自动分区开始。\n"
+"2. 在代表性工作负载下，记录每个 PP 阶段中 worker 的峰值内存和步进延迟。\n"
+"3. 如果最后一个阶段是瓶颈，则每次将一个目标隐藏层从最后一个阶段移动到 PP 排名较低的前一个阶段，例如从 `[31,30]` 改为 `[32,29]`。\n"
+"4. 每次更改后重复准确性和性能测试。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Moving too many layers can merely transfer the bottleneck to another stage, so\n"
+"do not select a partition using memory capacity alone."
+msgstr "移动过多层可能只是将瓶颈转移到另一个阶段，因此不要仅根据内存容量来选择分区。"
+
+msgid "## Advanced Scenarios"
+msgstr "## 高级场景"
+
+msgid "### PP with Speculative Decoding"
+msgstr "### 带投机解码的 PP"
+
+msgid ""
+"`VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION` partitions only the target model. Draft-model layers\n"
+"are not included in its layer sum, and their weight naming and layer layout\n"
+"depend on the specific speculative-decoding implementation."
+msgstr ""
+"`VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION` 仅对目标模型进行分区。草稿模型层不包含在其层数总和中，其权重命名和层布局取决于具体的投机解码实现。"
+
+msgid ""
+"In the current Model Runner V1 local MTP and EAGLE proposer path, the drafter is\n"
+"loaded on the last PP stage rather than partitioned across PP stages. Therefore,\n"
+"the last stage can contain:"
+msgstr ""
+"在当前 Model Runner V1 本地 MTP 和 EAGLE 提议者路径中，草稿模型加载在最后一个 PP 阶段上，而不是跨 PP "
+"阶段分区。因此，最后一个阶段可以包含："
+
+msgid ""
+"- Its target-model hidden layers.\n"
+"- The target model's output-side modules.\n"
+"- The local drafter and its supporting modules."
+msgstr ""
+"- 其目标模型的隐藏层。\n"
+"- 目标模型的输出侧模块。\n"
+"- 本地草稿模型及其支持模块。"
+
+msgid ""
+"If the last rank is constrained by memory or latency, reduce its target hidden\n"
+"layers with a custom partition. `draft_tensor_parallel_size` controls only the\n"
+"draft model's TP size; it does not define a draft-model PP partition."
+msgstr ""
+"如果最后一个排名受到内存或延迟的限制，请使用自定义分区减少其目标隐藏层。`draft_tensor_parallel_size` 仅控制草稿模型的 TP"
+" 大小；它不定义草稿模型的 PP 分区。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Speculative-decoding support varies by model, method, and model runner. See\n"
+"[Speculative Decoding](speculative_decoding.md) and the relevant model tutorial\n"
+"before enabling it with PP."
+msgstr ""
+"投机解码的支持因模型、方法和模型运行器而异。在将其与 PP "
+"一起启用之前，请参阅[投机解码](speculative_decoding.md)和相关模型教程。"
+
+msgid "### PP in P/D-Disaggregated Serving"
+msgstr "### P/D 分离服务中的 PP"
+
+msgid ""
+"PP is commonly enabled on the Prefill node, while the Decode node remains\n"
+"`PP1`. When using `MooncakeConnectorV1`, both the Prefill and Decode\n"
+"configurations must describe the actual Prefill topology."
+msgstr ""
+"PP 通常在 Prefill 节点上启用，而 Decode 节点保持 `PP1`。使用 `MooncakeConnectorV1` 时，Prefill "
+"和 Decode 配置都必须描述实际的 Prefill 拓扑。"
+
+msgid "| Setting | Prefill node | Decode node |"
+msgstr "| 设置 | Prefill 节点 | Decode 节点 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `--pipeline-parallel-size` | Actual Prefill PP size, for example `2`. | "
+"Currently `1`. |"
+msgstr "| `--pipeline-parallel-size` | 实际的 Prefill PP 大小，例如 `2`。 | 当前为 `1`。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `prefill.pp_size` | Actual Prefill PP size. | The same Prefill PP size. |"
+msgstr "| `prefill.pp_size` | 实际的 Prefill PP 大小。 | 相同的 Prefill PP 大小。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `prefill.pp_layer_partition` | Custom Prefill partition, if used. | The "
+"same custom Prefill partition. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| `prefill.pp_layer_partition` | 自定义 Prefill 分区（如果使用）。 | 相同的自定义 Prefill 分区。 "
+"|"
+
+msgid "| `decode.pp_size` | `1` | `1` |"
+msgstr "| `decode.pp_size` | `1` | `1` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION` | Set when the Prefill node uses a custom "
+"partition. | Do not copy the Prefill value to a `PP1` Decode process. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| `VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION` | 当 Prefill 节点使用自定义分区时设置。 | 不要将 Prefill 值复制到 "
+"`PP1` Decode 进程。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"For a 61-layer Prefill model using `TP8 PP2` and the custom partition\n"
+"`[32,29]`, include the following topology in `kv_connector_extra_config` on\n"
+"both sides:"
+msgstr ""
+"对于使用 `TP8 PP2` 和自定义分区 `[32,29]` 的 61 层 Prefill 模型，请在两侧的 "
+"`kv_connector_extra_config` 中包含以下拓扑："
+
+msgid "The Prefill process must also export:"
+msgstr "Prefill 进程还必须导出："
+
+msgid ""
+"If automatic partitioning is used, omit `pp_layer_partition` on both sides.\n"
+"The current Mooncake connector requires the Prefill TP size to be greater than\n"
+"or equal to the Decode TP size and to be an integer multiple of it."
+msgstr ""
+"如果使用自动分区，请在两侧省略 `pp_layer_partition`。当前的 Mooncake 连接器要求 Prefill TP 大小大于或等于 "
+"Decode TP 大小，并且是其整数倍。"
+
+msgid ""
+"For complete P/D startup commands, see\n"
+"[PD Disaggregation with Mooncake](../../tutorials/features/pd_disaggregation_mooncake_multi_node.md).\n"
+"For long-context Prefill optimization, see\n"
+"[Dynamic Chunked Pipeline Parallel](dynamic_chunk_pipeline_parallel.md)."
+msgstr ""
+"有关完整的 P/D 启动命令，请参阅[使用 Mooncake 进行 PD "
+"分离](../../tutorials/features/pd_disaggregation_mooncake_multi_node.md)。有关长上下文"
+" Prefill 优化，请参阅[动态分块流水线并行](dynamic_chunk_pipeline_parallel.md)。"
+
+msgid "## Performance Characteristics: PP Compared with TP"
+msgstr "## 性能特征：PP 与 TP 的比较"
+
+msgid ""
+"PP and TP distribute model execution in different ways, so neither strategy is\n"
+"universally faster. TP partitions supported operations within Transformer\n"
+"layers. TP workers participate in every layer and use collective communication\n"
+"to combine partial results, while components that are not partitioned can\n"
+"remain replicated. PP assigns consecutive layers to different stages and\n"
+"transfers intermediate tensors between adjacent stages. In a hybrid topology,\n"
+"TP communication remains inside each PP stage, while PP communication connects\n"
+"the stages."
+msgstr ""
+"PP 和 TP 以不同的方式分布模型执行，因此两种策略都不是普遍更快的。TP 在 Transformer 层内对支持的操作进行分区。TP worker "
+"参与每一层，并使用集合通信来合并部分结果，而未分区的组件可以保持复制。PP 将连续的层分配给不同的阶段，并在相邻阶段之间传输中间张量。在混合拓扑中，TP"
+" 通信保持在每个 PP 阶段内部，而 PP 通信连接各个阶段。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The primary performance advantage of PP over a large cross-node TP group is\n"
+"**communication locality**, rather than faster computation within an individual\n"
+"layer."
+msgstr "PP 相对于大型跨节点 TP 组的主要性能优势是**通信局部性**，而不是单个层内更快的计算。"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Aspect | Tensor Parallelism | Pipeline Parallelism | Performance "
+"implication |"
+msgstr "| 方面 | 张量并行 | 流水线并行 | 性能影响 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Model partition | Every TP rank participates in every layer and holds "
+"either a shard or a replica of each component. | Each PP stage executes only"
+" its assigned layers; TP can additionally shard those layers. | PP can "
+"extend model capacity without creating a very large TP group. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| 模型划分 | 每个TP rank参与每一层，并持有每个组件的分片或副本。 | 每个PP阶段仅执行其分配到的层；TP还可以对这些层进行分片。 | "
+"PP可以在不创建非常大的TP组的情况下扩展模型容量。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Communication | Collective operations can occur inside many Transformer "
+"layers. | Intermediate tensors are transferred between adjacent PP stages. |"
+" Keeping TP inside each node usually reduces the frequency of cross-node "
+"communication. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| 通信 | 集体通信操作可能发生在许多Transformer层内部。 | 中间张量在相邻的PP阶段之间传输。 | "
+"将TP保持在每个节点内通常可以减少跨节点通信的频率。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Single-request latency | All TP workers contribute to the same layer "
+"concurrently. | A request traverses the PP stages in sequence. | TP usually "
+"favors latency-sensitive, low-concurrency workloads when the TP interconnect"
+" is fast. |"
+msgstr ""
+
+msgid ""
+"| Steady-state throughput | A large TP group can lose efficiency to "
+"collective latency and smaller per-rank matrix operations. | Concurrent "
+"scheduler batches formed from independent requests or Prefill chunks can "
+"keep different stages occupied. | PP can improve throughput when the "
+"pipeline has enough work and the stages are balanced. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| 稳态吞吐量 | 大型TP组可能因集体通信延迟和更小的每rank矩阵运算而损失效率。 | "
+"由独立请求或Prefill块形成的并发调度器批次可以使不同阶段保持忙碌。 | 当流水线有足够的工作且各阶段均衡时，PP可以提高吞吐量。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Memory | Weights are sharded within each layer; some tensors can remain "
+"replicated. | Weights and KV cache are divided by layer, while edge stages "
+"also hold input-side or output-side modules. | Both reduce per-rank memory, "
+"but equal parallel sizes do not guarantee equal peak memory. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| 内存 | 权重在每一层内进行分片；某些张量可以保持复制。 | 权重和KV缓存按层划分，而边缘阶段还持有输入侧或输出侧的模块。 | "
+"两者都减少了每rank的内存，但相同的并行大小并不能保证相同的峰值内存。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Scaling constraints | The usable TP size can be limited by attention "
+"heads, KV heads, hidden dimensions, expert routing, or supported kernels. | "
+"The model must support PP and have partitionable layers. | PP is useful when"
+" increasing TP is invalid or no longer efficient. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| 扩展限制 | 可用的TP大小可能受到注意力头、KV头、隐藏维度、专家路由或支持的kernel的限制。 | 模型必须支持PP并且具有可划分的层。 | "
+"当增加TP无效或不再高效时，PP非常有用。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Main bottleneck | A slow collective delays every rank in the TP group. | "
+"The slowest stage and its boundary transfer limit the pipeline. | TP depends"
+" on collective efficiency; PP depends on stage balance and activation-"
+"transfer efficiency. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| 主要瓶颈 | 缓慢的集体通信会延迟TP组中的每个rank。 | 最慢的阶段及其边界传输限制了流水线。 | "
+"TP依赖于集体通信效率；PP依赖于阶段均衡和激活传输效率。 |"
+
+msgid "### Pipeline Bubbles and Workload Effects"
+msgstr "### 流水线气泡与负载影响"
+
+msgid ""
+"PP introduces idle time while work enters and leaves the pipeline, and whenever\n"
+"one stage takes longer than the others. This idle time is commonly called a\n"
+"pipeline bubble. Equal layer counts do not guarantee equal stage latency: the\n"
+"first and last stages can also execute embeddings, the final norm, LM head,\n"
+"logits processing, sampling, or a speculative-decoding drafter."
+msgstr ""
+"PP会在工作进入和离开流水线时，以及某个阶段比其他阶段耗时更长时引入空闲时间。这种空闲时间通常被称为流水线气泡。相等的层数并不能保证相等的阶段延迟：第一个和最后一个阶段还可能执行嵌入、最终归一化、LM头、logits处理、采样或投机解码草稿模型。"
+
+msgid "| Workload characteristic | Expected behavior |"
+msgstr "| 负载特征 | 预期行为 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| One request or low-concurrency Decode | There is little independent work "
+"to occupy multiple stages. Stage traversal and communication commonly "
+"increase latency relative to an efficient node-local TP baseline. Against a "
+"TP group that spans nodes, measure both configurations because cross-node "
+"collective latency can reverse the result. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| 单个请求或低并发Decode | "
+"几乎没有独立的工作来占用多个阶段。与高效的节点本地TP基线相比，阶段遍历和通信通常会增加延迟。对于跨节点的TP组，请测量两种配置，因为跨节点集体通信延迟可能会反转结果。"
+" |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| High concurrency with continuous batching | Concurrent scheduler batches "
+"can occupy different stages, reducing the relative pipeline bubble and "
+"improving throughput. |"
+msgstr "| 高并发与连续批处理 | 并发调度器批次可以占用不同的阶段，减少相对流水线气泡并提高吞吐量。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Long-context Prefill | More computation per chunk can amortize PP "
+"communication, and PP can provide the memory capacity required by long "
+"contexts. |"
+msgstr "| 长上下文Prefill | 每个块更多的计算可以摊销PP通信，并且PP可以提供长上下文所需的内存容量。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Variable prompt lengths | Batch and chunk durations vary, so a fixed-"
+"length benchmark can hide stage imbalance. |"
+msgstr "| 可变的提示长度 | 批次和块持续时间各不相同，因此固定长度的基准测试可能掩盖阶段不平衡。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Unbalanced layer partition | The slowest stage makes the other stages wait"
+" and limits steady-state throughput. |"
+msgstr "| 不平衡的层划分 | 最慢的阶段使其他阶段等待，并限制了稳态吞吐量。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"PP is therefore more likely to outperform cross-node TP when TP can remain\n"
+"inside each node, the stages can be balanced by measured latency and memory,\n"
+"and the workload provides enough concurrent requests or Prefill chunks to keep\n"
+"the pipeline occupied. TP remains the preferred baseline when the model fits in\n"
+"one node, low-concurrency latency is the primary objective, or the stages cannot\n"
+"be balanced."
+msgstr ""
+"因此，当TP可以保持在每个节点内、阶段可以通过测量的延迟和内存进行均衡，并且负载提供足够的并发请求或Prefill块来保持流水线忙碌时，PP更有可能优于跨节点TP。当模型适合单个节点、低并发延迟是主要目标或阶段无法均衡时，TP仍然是首选基线。"
+
+msgid ""
+"For long-context Prefill workloads, consider\n"
+"[Dynamic Chunked Pipeline Parallel](dynamic_chunk_pipeline_parallel.md), which\n"
+"adjusts chunk sizes using measured execution time to reduce stage idle time."
+msgstr ""
+"对于长上下文Prefill负载，请考虑[动态分块流水线并行](dynamic_chunk_pipeline_parallel.md)，它使用测量的执行时间来调整块大小，以减少阶段空闲时间。"
+
+msgid "## Compatibility and Limitations"
+msgstr "## 兼容性与限制"
+
+msgid ""
+"- PP cannot be combined with Prefill Context Parallelism (PCP) in the current\n"
+"  release. See [Context Parallel](context_parallel.md).\n"
+"- Xlite graph mode is not compatible with PP.\n"
+"- Sparse KV Cache Offload does not support PP.\n"
+"- `MooncakeConnectorV1` currently requires the Decode-side PP size to be `1`.\n"
+"- For cross-node MoE deployments over RoCE, PP and DP cannot currently be\n"
+"  enabled together because the `MoeDistributeDispatch` communication path does\n"
+"  not support this combined topology.\n"
+"- Feature combinations remain model-specific. Check the relevant feature guide\n"
+"  before production deployment."
+msgstr ""
+"- 当前版本中，PP不能与Prefill上下文并行（PCP）结合使用。请参阅[上下文并行](context_parallel.md)。\n"
+"- Xlite图模式与PP不兼容。\n"
+"- 稀疏KV缓存卸载不支持PP。\n"
+"- `MooncakeConnectorV1`目前要求Decode侧PP大小为`1`。\n"
+"- 对于通过RoCE的跨节点MoE部署，PP和DP目前不能同时启用，因为`MoeDistributeDispatch`通信路径不支持这种组合拓扑。\n"
+"- 功能组合仍然是模型特定的。在生产部署之前，请查阅相关的功能指南。"
+
+msgid "## Troubleshooting"
+msgstr "## 故障排除"
+
+msgid "| Symptom | Checks and actions |"
+msgstr "| 症状 | 检查与操作 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Startup reports insufficient resources | Confirm that visible NPUs satisfy"
+" the selected DP/PP/TP topology and that Ray sees every expected NPU. |"
+msgstr "| 启动时报告资源不足 | 确认可见的NPU满足所选的DP/PP/TP拓扑，并且Ray能看到每个预期的NPU。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Startup rejects `VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION` | Check that the entry count "
+"equals the PP size and that the sum equals the target hidden-layer count. |"
+msgstr "| 启动时拒绝`VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION` | 检查条目数是否等于PP大小，并且总和是否等于目标隐藏层数。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| One PP rank runs out of memory | Check whether it is the last stage or "
+"hosts a local drafter. Measure all ranks, then move one target layer at a "
+"time. |"
+msgstr "| 某个PP rank内存不足 | 检查它是否是最后一个阶段或托管了本地草稿模型。测量所有rank，然后一次移动一个目标层。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| The first request hangs | Retry with smaller sequence and batch limits. "
+"Use `--enforce-eager` to determine whether graph capture is involved, and "
+"verify inter-rank communication. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| 第一个请求挂起 | 使用较小的序列和批次限制重试。使用`--enforce-eager`来确定是否涉及图捕获，并验证rank间通信。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| An MP worker cannot join the head node | Verify that both nodes use the "
+"same master address, master port, node count, model, and parallel sizes; "
+"that each node rank is unique; and that the master port is reachable. The "
+"worker command must include `--headless`. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| MP工作节点无法加入头节点 | 验证两个节点使用相同的主地址、主端口、节点数量、模型和并行大小；每个节点排名唯一；主端口可访问。工作节点命令必须包含"
+" `--headless`。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| A Ray deployment hangs or misses ranks | Verify identical environments, "
+"model paths, communication variables, and Ray resources on every node. |"
+msgstr "| Ray部署挂起或缺少排名 | 验证每个节点上的环境、模型路径、通信变量和Ray资源一致。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| A cross-node RoCE MoE deployment fails or hangs after enabling PP and DP |"
+" Keep either the PP size or the DP size at `1`; the current "
+"`MoeDistributeDispatch` path does not support this combined topology. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| 启用PP和DP后，跨节点RoCE MoE部署失败或挂起 | "
+"将PP大小或DP大小保持为`1`；当前的`MoeDistributeDispatch`路径不支持这种组合拓扑。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| P/D handshake times out | Compare the P/D connector topology, "
+"`prefill.pp_size`, optional `prefill.pp_layer_partition`, and the available "
+"`kv_port` range. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| P/D握手超时 | "
+"比较P/D连接器拓扑、`prefill.pp_size`、可选的`prefill.pp_layer_partition`以及可用的`kv_port`范围。"
+" |"
+
